title: Transfer Gamma0 coset cardinality to unimodular row classes
statement: Let N be a nonzero natural number and R=ℤ/Nℤ. Assume that every r,s∈R satisfying xr+ys=1 for some x,y∈R is the reduction of the bottom row of a matrix A∈SL₂(ℤ). Let U={(r,s)∈R² | ∃x,y∈R, xr+ys=1}, and let P be its quotient by (r,s)∼(r′,s′) iff a unit u∈R× satisfies ur=r′ and us=s′. Let H=Γ₀(N)={A∈SL₂(ℤ) | A₂₁=0 modulo N} and let Q=SL₂(ℤ)/H be the left-coset space. Then Q is finite and Nat.card Q=Nat.card P.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], (∀ r s : ZMod N, (∃ x y : ZMod N, x * r + y * s = 1) → ∃ A : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ, (A 1 0 : ZMod N) = r ∧ (A 1 1 : ZMod N) = s) → let P := Quot (fun v w : {v : ZMod (N) × ZMod (N) // ∃ x y : ZMod (N), x * v.1 + y * v.2 = 1} => ∃ u : (ZMod (N))ˣ, (u : ZMod (N)) * v.1.1 = w.1.1 ∧ (u : ZMod (N)) * v.1.2 = w.1.2); let Q := (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) ⧸ CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N; Finite Q ∧ Nat.card Q = Nat.card P
